module_summary: dash_main.c is the dashboard shell: the section table and tab switching, the never-returning DashRun main loop (input, throttled device/disc/remote polls, rendering), the boot-time launch-key/auto-launch emulation, the SELECT quick-launch overlay, the global START menu and the launch/MISC-command dispatch into ExecuteMainAction. dash_png.c decodes PNG artwork with libpng straight into a downscaled CT32 thumbnail using a streaming box filter. dash_ps1_card.c is the PS1 memory-card-image tool: it lists saves in .mcd/.gme/.vgs/.vmp/.mcx images, imports, exports, converts and deletes saves, makes new cards, and writes every change with a pre-check, a verified safety copy, an in-place rewrite and a read-back compare; the format work is in mc_ps1_card.c and mc_save_export.c.

reusable_helpers.name: dashPngLoadFile
reusable_helpers.what: loads a PNG through the gen* file layer and decodes it into a size-capped, box-filtered CT32 buffer

reusable_helpers.name: p1ReadAll
reusable_helpers.what: reads exactly n bytes from a gen* fd, looping over short reads

reusable_helpers.name: p1FreeName
reusable_helpers.what: builds folder+stem+ext and finds a free name with -2..-99 suffixes

reusable_helpers.name: p1WriteAll
reusable_helpers.what: rewrites an existing file in place in 32 KB chunks without create/truncate

reusable_helpers.name: p1Base
reusable_helpers.what: basename after the last '/' or ':' of a PS2 device path

reusable_helpers.name: argSidecarExists
reusable_helpers.what: checks whether the <elf-without-ext>.arg sidecar of an ELF exists

reusable_helpers.name: dashEnsureIpConfig
reusable_helpers.what: runs getIpConfig on the worker when it owns IO, else on the caller

findings.title: src/dash_files.c is unreachable: the DEVICES section can never be selected, so dashDevicesScreen and everything behind it is dead
findings.problem: dashDevicesScreen (dash_files.c:731) is reached only through screens[DASH_SEC_DEVICES] in dash_main.c:44, but `section` is only assigned at dash_main.c:235 (after 208-213 map DEVICES to FILES) and 1324-1336 (same mapping, else a visible_sections entry), so it is never DASH_SEC_DEVICES. All other code in dash_files.c (files*/dev*/storage* screens, openDevice, startDevice) is static and reached only from that screen; dashFilesPoll, the one external entry, returns at once because pend.active is set only by the dead startDevice. files_mode/S_FILES_MODE only steer these dead screens.
findings.fix: Delete src/dash_files.c and its ps2.yaml:597 entry, the dashFilesPoll() call (dash_main.c:1450) and prototype, the dashDevicesScreen extern, and put NULL (or &dashFilesScreen) in the DEVICES slot of screens[]. Optionally drop the then-meaningless S_FILES_MODE cases and files_mode field (keep reading the CNF key as a no-op). Update or delete the host tests that grep dash_files.c (listed in evidence).
findings.benefit: ~734 source lines removed. dash_files.o keeps 13188 B .text + 112 B .rodata in the ELF and 30520 B .bss in RAM (MEASURED: evidence raw/link/wLaunchELF-contrib-by-object.tsv); gc cannot drop it because screens[] references dashDevicesScreen.
findings.evidence: Grep 'section\s*=' in dash_main.c: only 24, 235, 1324-1336; dashSwitchSection maps DEVICES->FILES (210-211) and dashBackSection/dashVisibleSectionAt return only visible_sections {HOME,FILES,TOOLS,SETTINGS} (48). screens[] is static, indexed only by section. grep dashDevicesScreen: dash_internal.h:1022, dash_files.c:731, dash_main.c:44 only. grep storage*/dev*/dashFilesListScreen/dashDevicesGridScreen/openDevice/startDevice: only inside dash_files.c. pend.active=1 only at dash_files.c:131 (startDevice). files_mode read only in dash_files.c 684-723. Tests reading dash_files.c: test_dashboard_console_summary.py, test_files_tab_lifecycle.py, test_feedback_35_82.py, test_navigation_wraparound.py, test_pccf_fs.py, test_saildot4k_wins.py, test_root_mc_poll.py, test_selector_centering.py, test_udpfs_retry.py, test_zack_feedback.py, test_zack_storage_drivers.py. Size row from wLaunchELF-contrib-by-object.tsv for build/obj/wLaunchELF/src/dash_files.o.

findings.title: Dead 'dashboard enabled' option: DashIsEnabled() has no caller and S_ENABLED is in no settings row
findings.problem: DashIsEnabled is referenced only by its prototype (dash.h:18); the gc map already discards it. dashCfg.enabled is forced to 1 on load ('the dashboard is the only shell now', dash_store.c:309) and S_ENABLED appears only in its enum line and two switch cases, so no settings row can show or change it; the keep_enabled save/restore in dash_settings.c:2753-2759 protects a value that is always 1.
findings.fix: Delete DashIsEnabled and its prototype, the S_ENABLED enum value and its two cases, and the keep_enabled lines. Either keep writing 'Dash_Enabled = 1' as a literal for old builds that read the file, or drop the field and the key.
findings.benefit: ~15 lines removed; DashIsEnabled code is already gc-discarded (36 B, MEASURED wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv:40), so ELF change is a few bytes of switch code (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep DashIsEnabled over src/Launchstation: dash.h:18, dash_main.c:200 only. Grep S_ENABLED: dash_settings.c:52, 1021, 1701 only (no row table entry). Grep dashCfg.enabled: dash_store.c:239,309 (always 1), dash_settings.c:1022,1702,2753,2759, dash_main.c:203. docs-site/content/configuration.html:89 documents Dash_Enabled as retained for compatibility, always enabled.

findings.title: Unused section-name helpers, write-only prev_section and a duplicate extern in dash_main.c
findings.problem: dashVisibleSectionName has no caller; dashSectionName is called only by it, and section_names only by dashSectionName (both functions are already gc-discarded). prev_section is assigned at 234 and never read. `extern u32 paddata;` is declared twice in the same file (267 and 914).
findings.fix: Delete dashVisibleSectionName, dashSectionName, section_names and their two prototypes, delete prev_section and its assignment, and delete the second paddata extern. test_unified_dashboard_navigation.py:36 uses the text 'const char *dashSectionName' as a slice anchor and needs another anchor.
findings.benefit: ~14 lines removed; functions already gc-discarded (216+52 B MEASURED, wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv:37,39); section_names stays in .rodata without -fdata-sections: ~24 B pointers + ~37 B strings (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep dashVisibleSectionName: dash_main.c:126 and dash_internal.h:1057 only. Grep dashSectionName (word): dash_main.c:51,128, dash_internal.h:1040, docs/test anchor only. Grep section_names: dash_main.c:46,53. Grep prev_section: dash_main.c:25,234 and a test mock. Grep 'extern u32 paddata': dash_main.c:267,914, dash_ui.c:15.

findings.title: dash_png.c: box-filter accumulate and row-flush code written twice/three times
findings.problem: The interlaced and non-interlaced branches contain the same 21-line per-row loop (flush destination row on dy change, then accumulate the source row); they differ only in where the row comes from (memcpy from `full` vs png_read_row). The 4-line flush body appears a third time for the final row.
findings.fix: Use one row loop: take the row from `full` (point px at it, no memcpy) when the image is interlaced, else png_read_row into `row`; put the flush in one small static function used inside the loop and after it.
findings.benefit: ~22 lines removed and one copy of the loop code (a few hundred bytes of .text, INFERRED); also drops a w*4-byte memcpy per row for interlaced images.
findings.evidence: Read dash_png.c:139-209: lines 158-176 and 183-201 are textually identical; 159-163, 184-188 and 205-208 are the same flush. Lead dupes-blocks.tsv agrees (16 normalised lines).

findings.title: dash_png.c leaks the interlaced full-image buffer and row table when libpng longjmps inside png_read_image
findings.problem: full (up to 256*256*4 = 256 KB) and rows are block-local, non-volatile and not freed by the setjmp handler, which frees only row/acc/acc_n/dst. A truncated or CRC-damaged interlaced PNG up to 256x256 used as cover/artwork makes pngReadMem or libpng call png_error during png_read_image, and both buffers leak on every such decode (dash_art.c:343/513, dash_image.c:111).
findings.fix: Declare full and rows at function scope as volatile pointers initialised to NULL and free them in the setjmp handler (and set them NULL after the normal frees). Fold this into the loop merge of finding 4.
findings.justification: Adds about 3 lines; it is the smallest change that stops a leak of up to ~257 KB of EE heap per damaged interlaced image, which accumulates across art loads.
findings.benefit: Stops a leak of w*h*4 + h*4 bytes (<= 257 KB, INFERRED from the 256*256 cap at line 96) per failed interlaced decode.
findings.evidence: Read dash_png.c:25-35 (png_error on truncated input), 43-47 (error handler longjmps), 77-84 (handler frees only row/acc/acc_n/dst), 139-154 (full/rows locals, png_read_image). Callers: dash_art.c:343, 513 and dash_image.c:111 via dashPngLoadFile.

findings.title: Redundant code paths in dash_main.c: unreachable MISC check, duplicated firstInit branch, always-1 return, one-line poll wrappers
findings.problem: runMiscCommand's Configure/Exploit check (398-399) cannot match: its only caller dashRunMisc returns for both at 456-460 and 474-477. In firstInit `dashAppCount >= 0` is always true and both branches call dashDevicesAutoStart. dashOpenTextEditor always returns 1, so the check at dash_apps.c:196 never fires and the prototype comment ('0 = the user backed out') is wrong. pollPcGameReceiver/pollRemotePcCommand are 6-line wrappers adding the same HOME test, each called once (1459-1460).
findings.fix: Delete 398-399. In firstInit call dashDevicesAutoStart() once and then dashRescanLibrary(0) when dashLibLoadCache() < 0 || dashCfg.autoscan. Make dashOpenTextEditor void and drop the dash_apps.c:196 test. Replace the two wrappers with one `if (section == DASH_SEC_HOME)` around the two Impl calls at 1459-1460.
findings.benefit: ~22 lines removed, no behaviour change; a few dozen bytes of .text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: runMiscCommand is static, single call at dash_main.c:494. dashAppCount is a count: assigned 0 or nfresh, decremented only after a removal (dash_lib.c:24,497,523,591,929). dashOpenTextEditor callers: dash_main.c:471, dash_files.c:324, dash_tools.c:1622, dash_browser.c:767,3003 ignore the result; dash_apps.c:196 tests it. pollPcGameReceiver/pollRemotePcCommand referenced only at 798-810 and 1459-1460.

findings.title: Boot launch-key / auto-launch countdown logic written twice in bootBegin and bootUpdate
findings.problem: The 'held launch key runs, else start the AUTO countdown' block appears in bootBegin's Init_Delay==0 branch and again in bootUpdate when the delay expires.
findings.fix: In bootBegin always enter boot_phase 1 with boot_phase_end = Timer() + Init_Delay*1000 and drop the else branch; bootUpdate then handles both cases on the next frame.
findings.benefit: ~10 lines removed (INFERRED); with Init_Delay 0 the held key is read one frame later.
findings.evidence: Read dash_main.c:1072-1128; bootBegin is called once at 1395 when from_boot; boot_phase 1 zeroes input in the main loop (1411-1415), so the only change is a one-frame delay of bootHeldLaunchKey.

findings.title: p1Base duplicates ctBaseName from dash_card_tool.c; lkLabel repeats the same basename code
findings.problem: p1Base and ctBaseName are byte-for-byte the same 8-line function (basename after last '/' or ':'); lkLabel open-codes it again. dash_ps1_card.c already includes dash_card_tool.h.
findings.fix: Make ctBaseName non-static with a prototype in dash_card_tool.h (or a dash_internal.h helper), delete p1Base and use it in dash_ps1_card.c and lkLabel.
findings.benefit: ~9 lines removed net (8 + 3 removed, 1 prototype and include added), one copy of a tiny function (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep "strrchr\([a-z_]+, ':'\)" over src: dash_card_tool.c:187-191 identical to dash_ps1_card.c:40-44; dash_main.c:1029-1032 same logic. Other matches (neutrino_iso.c, elf.c, editor.c) differ (copy into buffers / handle both).

findings.title: dash_ps1_card.c has three hand-written whole-file read loops
findings.problem: p1Load (open, size check, malloc, chunked read loop) and p1ReadFile (open, size check, malloc, read loop) are the same routine with different size limits, and both re-implement p1ReadAll, which already loops genRead until n bytes arrive.
findings.fix: Give p1ReadFile min/max size parameters and use p1ReadAll for its loop; have p1Load call p1ReadFile(path, PS1_CARD_SIZE, PS1_CARD_FILE_MAX, ...) and keep only the container parsing.
findings.benefit: ~16 lines removed (INFERRED); p1Load's 32 KB chunking is dropped, as p1ReadFile and dashLoadTextFile already read whole files in one genRead.
findings.evidence: Read dash_ps1_card.c:49-92 and 202-237. p1Load callers: 165, 180 (commit pre-check and read-back), 559, 600. p1ReadFile callers: 245, 417, 471. dashLoadTextFile (dash_store.c:105-144) reads up to 512 KB with an unchunked genRead loop, so a single large read is already used on the same devices; whether some device needs 32 KB chunks was not verified (INFERRED).

findings.title: Development-only #ifdef blocks that no build defines: DASH_AUTOTEST, DASH_THEME_TOUR, WLE_BOOT_DIAGNOSTICS
findings.problem: None of the three macros is set by ps2.yaml or configure_ds34.py; they guard a demo library and button-replay script (DASH_AUTOTEST), a theme slideshow (DASH_THEME_TOUR) and six 'Boot check N' drawMsg prints (WLE_BOOT_DIAGNOSTICS). docs/dashboard.md:601-604 and docs/themes.md:436 describe the first two as dev aids to enable by hand.
findings.fix: Delete the blocks and include/dash_autotest.h, plus the doc paragraphs, unless the owner still uses these emulator aids; the boot-check prints at least are leftover debug output.
findings.benefit: ~115 source lines removed; no ELF change since the code is never compiled (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep DASH_AUTOTEST|DASH_THEME_TOUR|WLE_BOOT_DIAGNOSTICS over src/Launchstation (excluding docs): only the #ifdef sites listed, pad.c:284-325, dash_autotest.h; no ps2.yaml/scripts/workflow mention (brief section 2 and lead cond-macros-undefined.tsv agree). Docs: docs/dashboard.md:601-604, docs/themes.md:436, docs/plans/2026-10-18-tester-follow-up.md:49.

findings.title: dash_ps1_card.c repeats the read-and-parse-save sequence and the folder-of-path idiom
findings.problem: p1ReadSave and dashPs1SaveConvert both do p1ReadFile, the same two-string error choice, ps1SaveFromFile, free and an error modal, differing only in the title ('Not imported'/'Not converted') and the name hint; ConvertMany repeats the error strings a third time. 'copy path, cut at p1Base' is written four times and the on-card test twice.
findings.fix: Give p1ReadSave a hint and a title argument and call it from dashPs1SaveConvert; keep the two error strings in one place; add a 2-line p1Folder(path, out) for the four copies.
findings.benefit: ~12 lines removed net (INFERRED); one copy of two message strings in .rodata.
findings.evidence: Read dash_ps1_card.c:241-259, 409-446, 452-495; strings 'Too big or empty for a PS1 save.' at 249, 420, 473 and 'The file could not be read.' at 249, 420, 473; dashStrCopy+p1Base cut at 279-280, 399-400, 439-440, 582-583; on_card expression at 423 and 459.
